title: Scaling across threads
intro: Throughput of one shared engine on `np-places-lite.tgd`: each thread takes the current snapshot for every query, as a server's handlers do, and runs `get`, `reverse` (10 nearest), `admin_at`, `tz_at` and `search` (10 hits) in turn. The best of three rounds per thread count. The gate fails when four threads reach less than 1.5× one thread, the mark of a lock on the query path; the machine is shared and mixes performance and efficiency cores, so the figures are a floor.
